shortDescription: We need your lance to run a time critical patrol across this sector. Hit each waypoint as quickly as you can and report back on what you find out there. Killing the enemy is not a priority, timely information is. Waypoints are timed. Miss one and the contract fails. This is a test for this mission shape.
longDescription: Keep moving fast on this one, Commander, If you stop to fight everything, you will not make the dust off in time.

objectiveList.title: Reach Waypoint 1 in 6 rounds with 1 Mech
Reach Waypoint 2 in 5 rounds with 1 Mech
Reach Waypoint 3 in 7 rounds with your entire lance
Reach Waypoint 4 in 6 rounds with your entire lance

dialogueContent.words: Patrol route is marked for us, Commander. Hit every waypoint before you run out of time. Do not linger and get to the Waypoint now.
Clock's half gone. Get to the waypoint.
One round left to reach the waypoint.
Good work, Commander. Waypoint 2 is ahead, and we are advised that there are tanks in the area.
Head, for Waypoint 3 at the River Base.
Turrets just came up, take them out and lock down Waypoint 4.
Dropship is inbound. Get to Waypoint 5.
Window is gone. We are pulling you out.
Patrol complete, time to come home. Nice footwork there, Commander.
